# leftovr

> leftovr is an iPhone app that turns the food a household already owns into dinner.
> Photograph your fridge or pantry (up to three shots) or scan a grocery receipt, and
> leftovr fills your kitchen, ranks everything by what should be eaten first, generates
> recipes using only those ingredients, and removes them when you cook. Made by Two Brick
> Labs. Last updated 2026-11-10.

## What it does

- **Pantry photo** (the main way in): up to three photos of a shelf, the fridge or the
  counter; leftovr reads what it can see and you confirm the list.
- **Four more ways to add food**: receipt photo, PDF e-receipt, barcode scan, manual add.
  Barcode and manual add are free and unlimited.
- **Eat-first ranking**: every item carries an estimated freshness window ("best today", "this
  week"). The items closest to spoiling sit on top.
- **Recipe generation from your kitchen only**: you pick the meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner,
  snack or side), how long you have, the type of food and the number of servings. AI writes up
  to three recipes (one on the free plan) using ingredients the household already has, starting
  with the food that needs using first. It assumes only water, salt, pepper, cooking oil and
  common dried herbs. Recipes are capped at 8 steps and 12 ingredients.
- **Automatic depletion**: tapping "I cooked this" removes or reduces those ingredients. No
  re-tracking by hand.
- **Shared household**: up to three people share one synced kitchen (Household plan).
- **Insights**: money saved, items used vs. tossed, go-to dinners, per week / month / year.
- **Languages**: English and Serbian, including generated recipes.
- **Platform**: iPhone only. No smart fridge, sensors or scales needed.

## Questions leftovr answers

- **What can I cook with what I already have?** leftovr writes recipes from the food in your
  kitchen, so every main ingredient is something you own.
- **Is there an app that makes recipes from what's in my fridge?** Yes, leftovr, on iPhone. You
  photograph the fridge or scan a receipt once instead of typing ingredients each time.
- **How do I use up food before it goes off?** Everything is ranked by how soon it should be
  eaten, and recipes start with those items.
- **How do I stop throwing food away?** Cooking a recipe removes what you used, so the kitchen
  list stays true and the next suggestion uses what is left.

## What it is not

- Not a meal planner that plans first and sends you shopping.
- Not a recipe search engine you type ingredients into each time.
- Not an expiry list you maintain by hand, one barcode at a time.
- Freshness dates are estimates by item type, not guarantees, and are editable.

## Status

In early access. The waitlist at https://leftovr.co/#get is the way in.

## Pricing

Free to start: first scan (pantry photo or receipt) and first recipe generation, plus
unlimited manual and barcode add. Premium $6.99/month or $44.99/year. Household (up to 3 people) $9.99/month or
$69.99/year. Yearly plans start with a 7-day free trial. Full detail: https://leftovr.co/pricing.md

## Guides

- [Meal Planner, Pantry App or Ingredient Search: Which Fits?](https://leftovr.co/blog/meal-planner-vs-pantry-app-vs-ingredient-search/): Four kinds of tools solve dinner differently. Here is what each asks of you, where each breaks, and who each one suits.
- [How to Stop Throwing Away Food: 7 Habits That Work](https://leftovr.co/blog/stop-throwing-away-food/): Most food that gets thrown out was perfectly good on the day you bought it. The fix is mostly about attention, not willpower.
- [The Real Cost of Food Waste for Your Household](https://leftovr.co/blog/real-cost-of-food-waste/): Food waste is easy to ignore because it is spread across many small bin trips. Added up, it is a real line in the budget.
- [Meal Planning From What You Already Have](https://leftovr.co/blog/meal-planning-from-what-you-have/): Look at the kitchen first, plan two to four dinners around what needs eating, and shop only for what is missing.
- [Photo, Receipt or Manual Entry for a Pantry Inventory](https://leftovr.co/blog/photo-receipt-or-manual-pantry-inventory/): Three ways to build a kitchen inventory, what each one misses, and why you should always check the list.
- [How Long Does Food Last? A Practical Storage Guide](https://leftovr.co/blog/how-long-does-food-last/): Dates on packs are a starting point. Storage, temperature and what you do with food matter more than the printed day.
- [Seven Dinners From an Almost Empty Fridge](https://leftovr.co/blog/seven-dinner-ideas-empty-fridge/): An empty fridge is rarely an empty kitchen. Five staples and a few seasonings cover a full week of dinners.
- [Shop Smarter: Buy Less and Cook More](https://leftovr.co/blog/shopping-smarter-buy-less-cook-more/): Smarter shopping is not buying less of everything. It is buying on purpose, so more of what you pay for becomes dinner.
- [Sharing a Kitchen Without the Food Chaos](https://leftovr.co/blog/sharing-kitchen-roommates-family/): Shared kitchens fail on information, not goodwill: nobody knows what is there, so everyone buys it again.
- [How to Use Leftover Ingredients Before They Spoil](https://leftovr.co/blog/use-leftover-ingredients/): Leftover ingredients are unfinished meals, not failures. Here is how to give each odd and end a job.
- [Why "What's for Dinner?" Is the Wrong Question](https://leftovr.co/blog/whats-for-dinner-wrong-question/): Dinner gets easier when you stop searching the whole world of recipes and start from the food that needs eating.

## Guides in Serbian (vodiči na srpskom)

- [Planer obroka, aplikacija za ostavu ili pretraga recepata?](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/planer-obroka-ili-aplikacija-za-ostavu/): Četiri vrste alata rešavaju večeru na različite načine. Evo šta svaki traži od tebe, gde puca i kome odgovara.
- [Kako da ne bacaš hranu: 7 navika koje stvarno rade](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/kako-da-ne-bacas-hranu/): Većina bačene hrane bila je savršeno dobra onog dana kad si je kupio. Rešenje je uglavnom u pažnji, ne u snazi volje.
- [Koliko te zaista košta bacanje hrane](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/koliko-kosta-bacanje-hrane/): Bacanje hrane je lako zanemariti jer je raspoređeno na mnogo malih odlazaka do kante. Kad se sabere, to je prava stavka u budžetu.
- [Planiranje obroka od onoga što već imaš](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/planiranje-obroka-od-onoga-sto-imas/): Prvo pogledaj kuhinju, isplaniraj dve do četiri večere oko onoga što treba pojesti i kupi samo ono što fali.
- [Slika, račun ili ručni unos: kako da popišeš ostavu](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/slika-racun-ili-rucni-unos/): Tri načina da popišeš namirnice u kuhinji, šta svaki propušta i zašto spisak uvek treba da proveriš.
- [Koliko traje hrana? Praktičan vodič za čuvanje](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/koliko-traje-hrana/): Datum na pakovanju je samo polazna tačka. Čuvanje, temperatura i ono što radiš sa hranom važniji su od odštampanog dana.
- [Sedam večera iz skoro praznog frižidera](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/sedam-vecera-iz-praznog-frizidera/): Prazan frižider retko znači praznu kuhinju. Šest osnovnih namirnica i malo začina pokrivaju celu nedelju večera.
- [Pametnija kupovina: kupi manje, kuvaj više](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/pametnija-kupovina/): Pametnija kupovina ne znači kupovati manje svega. Znači kupovati sa namerom, da više onoga što platiš postane večera.
- [Zajednička kuhinja bez haosa sa hranom](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/zajednicka-kuhinja/): Zajedničke kuhinje ne propadaju zbog loše volje, nego zbog manjka informacija: niko ne zna šta ima, pa svi kupuju ponovo.
- [Kako iskoristiti ostatke namirnica pre nego što se pokvare](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/kako-iskoristiti-ostatke/): Ostaci namirnica nisu promašaj, nego nedovršeni obroci. Evo kako da svaki ostatak dobije posao.
- [Zašto je „Šta ima za večeru?” pogrešno pitanje](https://leftovr.co/sr/blog/sta-ima-za-veceru-pogresno-pitanje/): Večera postaje lakša kad prestaneš da pretražuješ sve recepte sveta i kreneš od hrane koju treba pojesti.
